# Rule: Factory ownership convention changed

_Canonical rule slug:_ `factory-ownership-convention-changed`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A function returning a raw pointer keeps its declaration, but who owns the pointee changes (caller-owned new object versus library-owned shared object).
